name_zh: 布赖特-康拉德-戴蒙德-泰勒定理
category: number theory / elliptic curves and modular forms
literal_source_claim: If E/Q is an elliptic curve, then E is modular.
canonical_claim: Every elliptic curve over the rational numbers is modular in the equivalent senses defined in the primary paper.
domain_and_universes: Elliptic curves E over Q; the primary statement is not over arbitrary number fields or arbitrary commutative rings.
hypotheses: E is an elliptic curve over Q
conclusion: E is modular, using the six equivalent conditions stated on paper pages 845-846.
alternate_encodings: L(E,s) equals the L-series of an eigenform of weight 2 and level N(E)
the l-adic Galois representation of E is modular
there is a nonconstant Q-morphism X_1(N(E)) to E
excluded_degenerate_cases: Singular Weierstrass equations are not elliptic curves; curves over fields other than Q, abelian varieties of higher dimension, mod-l representations in Theorem B, and semistable-only modularity are not substitutes for Theorem A.
foundation_profile: Intended Lean 4 dependent type theory with mathlib; classical logic and choice requirements remain to be frozen with the formal target.
